title: Over priced & flimsy
text: Over priced & flimsy. I guess my short description would be cheap.  The picture shows the table setting beside a leather couch in a living room.  Definitely not living room quality.  It looks and feels like a cheap table you might put out on a patio.  If I saw it in a store before buying, I would maybe pay $15 or $20 for it.  I cannot believe I wasted $50 on it.  The frame is very then material and it just does not appear as big as it looks in the picture.
